text:
alex.p: PR #1423 is up — migration guide for Private deployments. Netlify preview is failing on the edge build. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423 

maria.chen: :eyes: on it. What's the exact failure? the preview link?

alex.p: netlify posted this: https://deploy-preview-1423--redwood-docs.netlify.app (503) and the build log shows an edge compile error. CI shows docs build failed step.

jordan.t: I pulled the Netlify logs — error looks like a Next/edge adapter problem when it bundles the mdx examples. snippet from CI:
```
Error: Could not compile edge function:
  /workspace/docs/content/guides/migration-private.mdx
  TypeError: Unsupported Node API in Edge runtime: fs.promises.readFile
```

sam.k: That fs call is from the code-example loader we added. Quick fix: gate that helper behind a `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' || typeof window !== 'undefined')` check OR mark the page as `runtime: 'nodejs'` so it skips edge.

maria.chen: I'd prefer not to change runtime for the whole page if we can avoid it. Could we inline a static example snippet (no runtime fs) just for the docs preview? less risky.

alex.p: good point. I can swap to inline code in the MDX for now so the preview builds. But I'd like reviewers to look at the content otherwise. @maria.chen @jordan.t can you review the text + SDK snippet after I push that change?

netlify-bot: Build failed — Deploy URL: https://deploy-preview-1423--redwood-docs.netlify.app — Status: failed (edge build)

ci-bot: Unit tests & lint: passed. Docs build: failed on netlify-preview step. Full CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/gh/docs/1423/build/56

jordan.t: If you need a quick local preview while you iterate: `yarn docs:dev` (root) and then open http://localhost:3000/docs/guides/migration-private — run `NEXT_PUBLIC_PREVIEW=true` if you want the same flags Netlify uses. Also `pnpm` works for folks using pnpm.

sam.k: For the record, Vercel previews don't attempt edge bundling in our current config; we could flip the PR preview to Vercel for this PR only if Netlify continues to choke. That requires a PR label `preview:vercel` so the infra bot routes it.

maria.chen: How long until you push the inline snippet, @alex.p? I can review after lunch. If CI passes and Netlify shows green on rebuild, can we merge by 3pm PT?

alex.p: I'll push the small change in ~20m. Will re-run CI and comment here with the new preview link. If Netlify still fails, I'll add `preview:vercel` label and ask infra to flip it. Merge plan: once Docs build + CI green and one approval from @maria.chen or @jordan.t, I'll merge and trigger a docs redeploy.

docs-bot: Reminder: merging will also trigger the docs-versioning workflow. Make sure frontmatter `stable: true` set if this is GA content.

maria.chen: quick note on the SDK snippet — update import path to `@redwood/inference` (we deprecated `redwood-client` last week). I'll check the text for any other deprecated names.

alex.p: thanks. pushing now. will paste the new preview URL when ready. :thumbsup:

(edited)
